title: Completing a computer science degree on Coursera
summary: A personal blog post about completing a computer science degree through Coursera's online learning platform, shared on Hacker News where it received significant community engagement with 227 points and 143 comments.
problem_solved: Explores whether completing a CS degree through online platforms like Coursera is a viable alternative to traditional university education.
why_valuable: Provides real-world insights and practical experience about the feasibility and effectiveness of obtaining a computer science degree through Coursera for career advancement or career switching.
